result.rationale: The diff adds `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, ... })` in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts. In fetch (undici/HTTP2), response.statusText can be empty string even on 200 responses, so this check can reject successful token refreshes; checking response.status (e.g. !response.ok) is the correct idiom. This is newly added code, so the defect is introduced by this diff.
